comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: Remote Philippine islands really show how misleading the word “paradise” can be. 🇵🇭🌊 Beautiful beaches can exist alongside limited freshwater, healthcare, electricity and serious environmental risks. What stands out most is how communities develop highly specific knowledge of tides, weather, fishing and wildlife that outsiders would need years to understand.

comments.text: This 4K footage is absolutely stunning. It’s fascinating to see how the locals on these untouched islands live such a peaceful life without modern conveniences. Really eye-opening documentary
